note: A test inventory is not a coverage percentage or proof that every workflow is secure. Existing tests were located, not executed in this audit.

assertions: Unknown and protected routes do not become public static files
API errors do not fall back to SPA HTML
Private data is not included in public sitemap/robots responses
flows.runtimeGap: Actual ingress cache/header attachment needs owner observation; no production probe.

assertions: Malformed or challenge-purpose claims cannot authenticate
Current DB account and role override stale signed state
Revoked, expired, idle, kicked or banned sessions are denied
flows.runtimeGap: Real HTTP cookie, Redis failure/recovery and simultaneous refresh need isolated services.

assertions: Expired/used/wrong-action recovery tokens fail
Concurrent recovery consumes once
MFA challenge is principal/credential-state-bound and replay-protected
Password and authenticator changes revoke old authority
flows.runtimeGap: Transactional token races need disposable PostgreSQL and browser delivery/redirect fixtures.

assertions: Non-superusers cannot manage accounts/roles
Superuser cannot be created by writable managed-role input
Role/status updates invalidate active permissions/sessions
flows.runtimeGap: Role cache invalidation across workers and in-flight requests needs isolated concurrency checks.

assertions: User sees only assigned own totals
Admin sees its group
Manager/superuser see all authorized monthly totals
Missing mapping never becomes unrestricted scope
flows.runtimeGap: End-to-end account switching/mapping changes need disposable DB fixtures.

assertions: Nickname proof is bound to activity, account and role
Stale credentials and forged actor fields are denied
Managers cannot mutate records
Idempotency does not replay data across scopes
flows.runtimeGap: Authorization/mutation races and replay after role or team changes need deterministic isolated schedules.

assertions: All six aliases enforce record access
Receipt IDs must belong to the authorized record
Client paths cannot attach arbitrary files
Realpath and document/image checks reject traversal and active content
flows.runtimeGap: External scanner, MIME/browser handling, symlink races and filesystem ACL need isolated fixtures; no production receipts.

assertions: Summary/monthly/daily/detail/export use consistent nickname/team scope
Direct record lookups cannot broaden report access
Target/calendar writes require intended role
flows.runtimeGap: Every filter/export combination and account lifecycle requires a browser plus disposable DB matrix.

assertions: Saved target ACL and revisions are checked
Private client results use current viewer identity
Source/export selection cannot broaden allowed scope
flows.runtimeGap: Multi-source target edits, export and backup/restore privacy need transactional fixtures.

assertions: JSON/multipart/parser paths share size and row budgets
Archive expansion and executable disguised files are rejected
Background status/cancel/resume binds requestedBy
Queued import does not escape staged-file namespace
flows.runtimeGap: Worker resource enforcement, cancel/retry and distributed quotas need isolated Redis/DB and scratch filesystem.

assertions: Shared datasets still require the appropriate module
SQL values/column identifiers are constrained
Deleted imports do not leak through alternate row/detail paths
Client preview URLs and exported cells are safe
flows.runtimeGap: Deleted-import row/read behavior remains a source-review lead; existing tests alone are not proof of tombstone enforcement.

assertions: Conversation history and writes bind the caller
AI aliases respect module and mutation authority
Feature-disabled state cannot invoke provider or branch mutations
Retrieval/model output cannot gain unauthorized data or actions
flows.runtimeGap: Conversation ownership and alternate-route policy need independent candidate validation and new denial regressions, not just existing success tests.

assertions: Settings/moderation/debug/backup operations require intended authority
Audit/activity responses avoid secret fields
Backup integrity and encryption fail closed
Restore does not resurrect unauthorized credentials or private state
flows.runtimeGap: Atomic restore, current-session revocation and failure rollback need isolated PostgreSQL and filesystem fixtures.

assertions: WS cookie handshake requires exact origin and current activity
Revoked/expired sockets cannot retain privileged subscriptions
Message/connection/queue limits bound shared work
Telemetry is bounded, schema-checked and provenance-checked
flows.runtimeGap: Shared Redis producer ACL, socket expiry/role-change and job delivery guarantees require isolated transports.

assertions: Blocked tab mounts no protected data tree
Web Locks, not heartbeat, grants ownership
Logout/account switch clears protected cache/state
Unsafe messages/navigation cannot change authority
flows.runtimeGap: Two-tab ownership, simultaneous refresh, opener/CSP and receipt PDF behavior need sandboxed Chromium.

assertions: Cookie mutations enforce CSRF/CORS/no-store
Secrets and production source maps are not released
Promotion binds tested immutable artifact identity
Production configuration fails closed on unsafe topology
flows.runtimeGap: Live branch protections, approval reviewers, ingress/firewall/ACL/key configuration and current CVE advisory data were not inspected.
